commitResults.messageTitle: Merge PR #99 fix ContactAssignment loading bug
commitResults.messageBody:
Old loading methods load `ContactAssignment` objects without error handling, resulting in possibly orphaned records of links between missing contacts or missing assignments.

This PR fixes the aforementioned issue by throwing errors if such orphaned records are found during loading, and falls back to the usual behaviour for when loading corrupted load files, which is to cancel loading and refresh the address book with an empty one.

commitResults.messageBody: Enable adding a contact to an optional class group in AddContactCommand. The command now stores a ClassGroupName, validates it via ClassGroupUtil and throws AllocateClassGroupCommand.MESSAGE_INVALID_CLASS_GROUP_NAME for invalid names, allocates the contact to the found ClassGroup, and still handles optional assignment allocation (using AllocateAssignmentCommand error constant). The parser now parses PREFIX_CLASS and passes the ClassGroupName into the command. Updated constructor signature and relevant imports.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for optional class/assignment parsing
commitResults.messageBody: Add unit tests to AddContactCommandParserTest verifying parsing of optional class and assignment fields. Tests include: success when both optional values are present, failures for repeated class/assignment prefixes (duplicate prefix error), and failures for invalid class or assignment values (constraint messages). Also add imports for ClassGroupName and AssignmentName.

Add several integration tests to AddContactCommandIntegrationTest covering allocation scenarios: failures for nonexistent class group and assignment, and success cases for adding a contact with an assignment, with a class group, and with both. Tests verify command feedback and model state changes (contact added, ContactAssignment created, and class group contains the contact ID). Also add required imports and test utilities (ClassGroupBuilder, TypicalClassGroups, Assignment/AssignmentName, ContactAssignment).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for invalid class/assignment names
commitResults.messageBody: Add two unit tests to AddContactCommandTest that assert a CommandException is thrown when AddContactCommand is given an invalid ClassGroupName or AssignmentName. Tests use ModelStubAcceptingContactAdded and verify error messages from AllocateClassGroupCommand and AllocateAssignmentCommand. Added corresponding imports for class/assignment name and command classes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for optional class/assignment parsing
commitResults.messageBody: Add two unit tests to AddContactCommandParserTest: parse_optionalClassPresent_success and parse_optionalAssignmentPresent_success. Each constructs an expected Contact from TypicalContacts.AMY and either a ClassGroupName or AssignmentName, then asserts the parser returns an AddContactCommand with the optional class or assignment populated (the other set to null). Tests use CliSyntax prefixes and CommandParserTestUtil.assertParseSuccess.

Add a unit test to AddContactCommandTest that verifies when both optional names are invalid, class group name validation is performed first. The test builds a valid contact but supplies an invalid ClassGroupName and invalid AssignmentName, executes the command against ModelStubAcceptingContactAdded, and asserts a CommandException with AllocateClassGroupCommand.MESSAGE_INVALID_CLASS_GROUP_NAME is thrown.
Remove the obsolete MESSAGE_INVALID_ASSIGNMENT_NAME constant from AddContactCommand.java to clean up dead code. This is a refactor-only change and does not alter runtime behavior.

Remove now-unused imports for AllocateClassGroupCommand and AllocateAssignmentCommand so tests assert the standardized error messages (class group/assignment not found).

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix typo and remove commented import

commitResults.messageBody: Renamed three test methods in AddContactCommandIntegrationTest to use the _commandFailure suffix instead of _throwsCommandException for consistent test naming. Methods updated: execute_duplicateContact_throwsCommandException -> execute_duplicateContact_commandFailure; execute_nonexistentClassGroup_throwsCommandException -> execute_nonexistentClassGroup_commandFailure; execute_nonexistentAssignment_throwsCommandException -> execute_nonexistentAssignment_commandFailure. No logic or behavior changes, only method name updates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Include optional fields in AddContact equals
commitResults.messageBody: Update AddContactCommand.equals to also compare optional fields (classGroupName and assignmentName) using Objects.equals. Expand AddContactCommandTest to cover equality/inequality cases for those optional fields: same optional fields -> equal; different class group or assignment -> not equal; presence vs absence of optional fields -> not equal.

Rename the add command to addcontact in the user guide and expand its documentation. This change updates the command format to include optional c/CLASS_NAME and ass/ASSIGNMENT_NAME prefixes, adds detailed validation rules for NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL and ADDRESS, and clarifies that class/assignment names must refer to existing entities (case-insensitive). A warning explaining failure behavior on missing classes/assignments or invalid parameters was added, and examples were updated to match the new command name and parameters.

Update UserGuide to reflect current CPP behavior: contact uniqueness is enforced by name only. Previously the guide stated name, phone number, and email must be unique; this change removes the phone/email uniqueness requirement to align docs with the app's actual duplicate-detection logic.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enable text wrapping in result display
commitResults.messageBody: Add wrapText="true" to the TextArea in ResultDisplay.fxml so long lines wrap instead of causing horizontal scrolling, improving readability of results.

Wire automatic height adjustment for ResultDisplay so the feedback area grows/shrinks with its text. Adds listeners on text, width and font and computes required height via a helper Text node, clamped between MIN_HEIGHT and MAX_HEIGHT. Uses Platform.runLater for initial/deferred layout and updates the TextArea and root Region min/pref/max heights. Also triggers adjustment from setFeedbackToUser. Removes the fixed pref/max height in MainWindow.fxml to allow dynamic sizing.

commitResults.messageTitle: Qualify static members and wrap Javadoc
commitResults.messageBody: Wraps the constructor Javadoc line and updates static references to be explicitly qualified with ResultDisplay (TEXTAREA_HORIZONTAL_PADDING, TEXTAREA_VERTICAL_PADDING, MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT, and clamp). These changes clarify static access and address formatting/style consistency in src/main/java/cpp/ui/ResultDisplay.java.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix usage message formatting in AddContactCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Remove an unintended newline in the AddContactCommand usage string so the assignment and tag prefix segments are rendered consecutively (fixes formatting of the help/example output).

Adjust ResultDisplay layout constants: reduce MAX_HEIGHT from 220 to 200 and increase TEXTAREA_VERTICAL_PADDING from 22 to 28. These changes tighten the component's max height and add vertical padding to improve spacing and avoid cramped text/overflow in the result display.
Remove extra leading spaces from a list item in docs/UserGuide.md to correct bullet formatting and ensure consistency with surrounding list items.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine command summary formatting and examples
commitResults.messageBody: Update docs/UserGuide.md command summary table for clarity and consistency: rename "Add" to "Add Contact", reflow table columns/spacing, and standardize example commands (include c/CS2103T-T10-1 in addcontact example and remove a stray token). Purely documentation/formatting changes to improve readability.

Update docs/UserGuide.md to broaden and clarify duplicate-detection wording: change the question from "duplicate contacts" to "duplicate entries" and update the answer to state that contacts, classes, and assignments must have unique names. Also adjust the example sentence to mention adding a contact, class, or assignment that violates the rule.

commitResults.messageTitle: Display classes and assignments in ViewContact
commitResults.messageBody: Enhance ViewContactCommand to include the contact's associated class groups and contact assignments when viewing a contact. Adds a helper formatContactAssignment to render assignment details (name, submitted, graded) and uses ReadOnlyAddressBook to resolve class/assignment display text. Expose getContactAssignmentsForContact in the Model API and delegate implementation in ModelManager; update ModelStub with the new method signature. Misc: import stream utilities and necessary model classes.

Make ViewContactCommand extend ViewCommand (remove unused Command import) so it fits the view command hierarchy. Update ViewCommandParser: import ViewContactCommand, change parseViewContact to return ViewContactCommand, and instantiate it with the parsed index instead of throwing UnsupportedOperationException. This wires up the contact view command implementation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update view contact to show Assignment details
Use list panels for class groups and assignments
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the single contactClassGroups label with StackPane placeholders and render ClassGroupListPanel / ContactAssignmentAssignmentListPanel into those placeholders. Add dynamic resizing (MAX_VISIBLE_ROWS, CARD_ROW_HEIGHT) and computeBlockHeight/resizeBlock to cap visible rows and set placeholder heights; make population null-safe and only instantiate panels when data exists. Update FXML to include the two placeholders and remove the old label. Remove the old formatClassGroups logic and unused Collectors import.

Introduce a new COMMAND_WORD_ALIAS 'addct' for AddContactCommand and include it in the command usage message. Update AddressBookParser to accept the alias and delegate to AddContactCommandParser. Add a unit test (parseCommand_addAlias) to verify the alias is parsed into an AddContactCommand. Improves usability by providing a shorter command form.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support multiple tags per tag prefix
commitResults.messageBody: Allow a single tag prefix to contain multiple space-separated tags by flattening and splitting tag values before parsing. Update AddContactCommand usage string and example to show the new syntax. Add/import List/ArrayList in the parser and add a unit test case verifying that multiple tags provided under one tag prefix are accepted.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse tags from single string in parsers/tests
commitResults.messageBody: Change ParserUtil.parseTags to accept a single String (splitting on whitespace) instead of a Collection<String>, and use a LinkedHashSet to collect parsed Tag objects. Update AddContactCommandParser and EditContactCommandParser to call the new parseTags(String) API, include PREFIX_TAG in duplicate-prefix verification, and remove the old flattening/helper logic (parseTagsForEdit). Adjust related imports and simplify tag handling. Update unit tests to match the new tag format and duplicate-prefix behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: single t/ syntax and add 'addct' alias
commitResults.messageBody: Update UserGuide.md to change tag usage to a single t/ prefix followed by space-separated tags (e.g., `t/friends owesMoney`) and clarify that repeating the t/ prefix is not accepted. Add an alias `addct` for `addcontact` with an example, adjust examples and parameter syntax notes to show `[t/TAG [TAG]...]`, and update the command summary to reflect the new tag format and alias. Minor formatting and example tweaks to keep documentation consistent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use addcontact and ContactName in docs
commitResults.messageBody: Update DeveloperGuide and diagram to reflect the renamed command and field: replace occurrences of 'add n/David ...' with 'addcontact n/David ...' and change 'Name' to 'ContactName' in the MSS/use-case text. Also update docs/diagrams/UndoRedoState2.puml title to match the new command. Keeps documentation consistent with the codebase's command and naming conventions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Require non-empty tags when adding contacts
commitResults.messageBody: Validate that tags are not empty when creating a Contact. Switch AddContactCommandParser to use ParserUtil.parseNonEmptyTags, and add ParserUtil.parseNonEmptyTags plus a MESSAGE_EMPTY_TAGS constant; parseNonEmptyTags delegates to parseTags and throws a ParseException if the resulting tag set is empty.

commitResults.messageTitle: Case-insensitive Tag equality; parse non-empty tags
commitResults.messageBody: Make Tag.equals and Tag.hashCode case-insensitive by normalizing tagName to lower case for comparisons and hashing. Add ParserUtil.parseNonEmptyTags to validate parsed tag sets are not empty, and update AddContactCommandParser to only parse tags when the tag prefix is present (otherwise use an empty set). Add unit tests to assert case-insensitive equals and hashCode behavior and a minor import in TagTest.
